components.name: Bulb Strand
components.description: Signature progress meter: a sagging wire whose bulbs light in amber, rani, leaf, warm order as work gets done.
components.css: .ds-strand { position: relative; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; padding: 6px 2px 2px; min-height: 26px; width: 280px; } .ds-wire { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 2px; height: 14px; border-bottom: 1.5px solid #3d4686; border-radius: 0 0 50% 50% / 0 0 100% 100%; } .ds-bulb { position: relative; width: 10px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50% 50% 46% 46% / 60% 60% 40% 40%; background: #262c5c; border: 1px solid #3a4180; transition: background-color 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-bulb:nth-child(n+4):nth-last-child(n+3) { top: 5px; } .ds-bulb::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: -4px; width: 4px; height: 4px; transform: translateX(-50%); background: #4a5293; border-radius: 1px; } .ds-on.ds-amber { background: #ffb703; border-color: #ffd36b; box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgb(255 183 3 / 75%); } .ds-on.ds-rani { background: #ff4f8b; border-color: #ff8db4; box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgb(255 79 139 / 75%); } .ds-on.ds-leaf { background: #2ee59d; border-color: #8af5c9; box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgb(46 229 157 / 70%); } .ds-strand:hover .ds-bulb:not(.ds-on) { border-color: #4a5293; }

narrative.overview:
Subham is a night street strung with serial lights. The ground is a deep indigo night, panels are dark lit glass edged with a single wire line, and colour arrives only as light: marigold, rani pink, leaf green and warm white bulbs. Every function of a celebration is a strand, and progress is shown literally as bulbs coming on. Things that are not yet done are unlit glass, never hidden; things that are done glow.

The system is dark-only (`color-scheme: dark`) and moderately dense: landing sections breathe on 5 to 6rem bands, while the app (wizard, dashboard, assistant) packs cards on a 1rem rhythm. One rounded, warm type family carries Latin, Devanagari, Tamil and Telugu with the same voice, so a plan in Tamil looks like it belongs to the same street as one in English. Motion is a bulb warming up: a soft blur-and-rise reveal, springs for tabs and steps, a chase along the WebGL strands. All of it falls still under reduced motion, and content is visible without JavaScript.

The world rejects the cream-and-serif planner page and the split hero over a row of feature cards; the build replaces both with a full-bleed night scene and features hung as tags from a wire.
keyCharacteristics: Indigo night ground, tonal panel steps, 1px wire borders.
Four bulb colours, used as light (glow shadows, lit states), not as flat fills for chrome.
Progress is a strand of bulbs (lit vs unlit glass), exposed as an ARIA meter.
Pill-shaped actions; amber is the single primary action colour and it glows.
Catenary wire curves (a sagging 1.5px line) as the recurring connector between grouped items.
One Indian-foundry type family (Baloo / Hind) across four scripts.

rules.name: The Light Is the Accent Rule
rules.body: Bulb colours appear as light: a lit bulb, a glow shadow, a tinted badge at 10 to 14% alpha, a coloured script word. Chrome (panels, borders, nav) stays in the indigo neutrals.

rules.name: The One Amber Action Rule
rules.body: Amber fill with a glow belongs to the primary action only. Secondary actions are bare wire (transparent with a bright-wire stroke) and turn amber only at the border on hover.

rules.name: The Bulb Order Rule
rules.body: Multi-bulb patterns cycle amber, rani, leaf, warm in that order (BulbStrand, the WebGL chase, the reprise, script words).

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Display and body each resolve through their script siblings via the font stack; never set a Latin-only face on text that may be localised.

rules.name: The Balanced Head Rule
rules.body: Headings use `text-wrap: balance` and slight negative tracking (-0.015em); body text is never tracked.

rules.name: The Lit Means Done Rule
rules.body: Glow is state. A bulb, tab marker or feature bulb glows only when its thing is active, selected or complete; at rest it is unlit glass.

dos: **Do** show progress as a Bulb Strand (lit vs unlit glass, Bulb Order) with a meter role and spoken value.
**Do** keep one amber, glowing primary action per view; pair it with a bare-wire secondary.
**Do** connect grouped items with the 1.5px sagging catenary wire in bright-wire.
**Do** draw icons from the shared Icon set (24px grid, 1.75 stroke, round caps and joins).

**Do** use the house ease `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` for state changes and springs (stiffness 120, damping 18) for tab and step entrances; keep content visible without JS and still under reduced motion.
**Do** keep every interactive target at least 44px and focus visible with the 2px warm outline.
donts: **Don't** use a cream or paper ground with serif display type; the world is the night street.
**Don't** compose a split hero over a row of feature cards.
**Don't** glow anything that is not active, selected or complete; unlit is the honest resting state.
**Don't** fill chrome (panels, nav, borders) with bulb colours; they are light, not paint.
**Don't** set white text on amber; use Lamp Soot (on-amber).
**Don't** introduce a Latin-only typeface for localisable text.
